instructor: As a person, Aleksander Degtyarev is very understanding, supportive, and kind. He always acted based on mutual respect and tried to help with all the problems I was facing. He managed to teach such a complex topic as linear algebra in a remarkably straightforward manner. Lastly, and most importantly, Aleksander Degtyarev is genuinely a great mathematician.
